content:
A big release for roc-parser focussed on fuzzing and oracles for correctness and spec conformance to 100%, adding comprehensive documentation (a lot of AI assistance for now -- so BETA docs), and performance tuning.

https://github.com/lukewilliamboswell/roc-parser/releases/tag/2.0.0

New docs site https://lukewilliamboswell.github.io/roc-parser/ which now includes detailed guides for parser combinators, working with the included modules for CSV, YAML, Markdown, HTTP, XML

Some rough benchmarks against Rust, Go and Python

So roughly on-par with Rust's csv crate, slower than Go's encoding/csv and faster than Python.
